title: Your Data. Your Trust.
tagline: Civic privacy principles and safety charter for Census 2027

censusActProtections.section15: Section 15 of the Census Act, 1948 provides absolute statutory protection for individual census schedules. Individual records cannot be used as evidence against any person in judicial or tax proceedings, nor can they be disclosed to third parties or other government enforcement agencies.
censusActProtections.anonymizedAggregates: Census results are published only in the form of statistical tables and demographic aggregates at village, ward, district, state, and national levels.

censusSaathiZeroPIIPrinciples.title: We Never Ask For Or Store Aadhaar Numbers
censusSaathiZeroPIIPrinciples.description: Census Saathi explicitly prohibits entering real 12-digit Aadhaar numbers or uploading any identity documents. All practice tools use clearly masked placeholders.

censusSaathiZeroPIIPrinciples.title: We Do Not Collect Real Census Questionnaires
censusSaathiZeroPIIPrinciples.description: Practice forms exist strictly in browser session memory to help you learn the format. Nothing is saved to remote databases.

censusSaathiZeroPIIPrinciples.title: No Account Required & Minimal Session Storage
censusSaathiZeroPIIPrinciples.description: You do not need to create an account, log in, or provide your phone number, email, or physical home address.

censusSaathiZeroPIIPrinciples.title: Server-Side PII Redaction Guardrails
censusSaathiZeroPIIPrinciples.description: Any AI query submitted is scrubbed server-side to strip accidental phone numbers or numerical identifiers before processing.

scamWarningSignals.detail: Any request for ₹50, ₹100, ₹500 or any processing charge is 100% fraudulent. Census participation is completely free.
No legitimate Census system or enumerator will ever ask for banking passwords, UPI PINs, or bank OTPs.
Never install APK files sent via WhatsApp or Telegram claiming to be the Census app. Use only official Play Store links or gov.in portals.
Enumerators only record information; they never collect physical property deeds, passports, or original certificates.

whatSaathiDoesNotCollect: Passport, PAN card, or Voter ID copies
Persistent chat logs tied to your identity
